cards.questionText:
Answer either Question 4 or Question 5.
Write about (a), (b) OR (c) in no less than 200 Japanese characters.
(a) You have just come back from holidaying in Ireland. Write to your Japanese e‐pal about your holiday. Include answers to the following questions.
(i) 何をしましたか。
(ii) どうでしたか。
OR
(b) Write a thank you letter to your Japanese teacher. Include answers to the following questions.
(i) 日本語のクラスはどうでしたか。
(ii) リービング・サートの後で、何をしますか。
OR
(c) You have just moved house with your family. Write a diary entry. Include answers to the following questions.
(i) どんな家（いえ）ですか。
(ii) その家（いえ）はどうですか。
